title.zh: 卷一百一十 表第五上: 三公表一
title.raw: 卷一百一十 表第五上: 三公表一 Volume 110 Tables 5: Three Ducal Ministers 1

sentences.zh: 古者三公之職，寅亮天地，燮理陰陽，以論道經邦者也。

translations.literal: In antiquity the office of the Three Ducal Ministers was to honor and illuminate Heaven and Earth, harmonize yin and yang, and discuss the Way to govern the state.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times the Three Ducal Ministers were charged with honoring Heaven and Earth, harmonizing yin and yang, and guiding the realm through discourse on the Way.

sentences.zh: 元初，以太師、太傅、太保為三公，自木華黎國王始為太師，後凡為三公者，皆國之元勳，而漢人則惟劉秉忠嘗為太保，其後鮮有聞矣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuan, the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian were made the Three Ducal Ministers. Starting from King Muqali as Grand Preceptor, thereafter all who became the Three Ducal Ministers were founding meritorious officials of the state; among Han Chinese only Liu Bingzhong once served as Grand Guardian — after that few are heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan dynasty the Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian constituted the Three Excellencies. Muqali, enfeoffed as king, was the first Grand Preceptor; thereafter every man raised to these three posts was a founding pillar of the realm. Among Han officials only Liu Bingzhong ever held Grand Guardian — and scarcely anyone among the Han after him.

sentences.zh: 其制又有大司徒、司徒、太尉、司空之屬，然其置否不常，人品或混，故置者又或開府不開府焉。

translations.literal: The system also had such posts as Grand Minister of Education, Minister of Education, Grand Commandant, and Minister of Works; yet whether they were established was not constant, and the caliber of appointees might be mixed; hence those who were appointed might or might not establish a bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The institution also recognized Grand Minister of Education, Minister of Education, Grand Commandant, and Minister of Works, among others; but these offices were not consistently filled, and appointees varied in standing — so some appointees opened a formal bureau and others did not.

sentences.zh: 若夫東宮，亦嘗置三師、三少，而不恒有也。

translations.literal: As for the Eastern Palace, it also at times had the Three Masters and Three Mentors, but they were not always in place.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's establishment likewise sometimes included the Three Masters and Three Minor Mentors, though these posts were not kept permanently.

sentences.zh: 今固不得而悉著之，惟自木華黎而下，得拜三公者若干人，作三公表。

translations.literal: Now they cannot all be fully recorded; only from Muqali downward, the several men who received appointment as the Three Ducal Ministers are set forth in the Table of the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: A full record of every holder is impossible here; this table lists only those from Muqali onward who were appointed to the three great offices.

cells.content: 按和林廣記多載國初之事，內有太師阿海、太傅禿懷、太保明安之名，及他公牘所報，亦間見之；然拜罷歲月之先後，不可考矣。故著于此。

translations.literal: The Extended Records of Karakorum contain much on affairs of the founding of the state, including the names of Grand Preceptor Ahai, Grand Tutor Tughuai, and Grand Guardian Ming'an; they also appear occasionally in other official documents reported; yet the sequence of their appointments and removals cannot be ascertained. They are therefore recorded here.
translations.idiomatic: The Extended Records of Karakorum preserve many accounts from the dynasty's founding, naming Grand Preceptor Ahai, Grand Tutor Tughuai, and Grand Guardian Ming'an; other official reports mention them as well, though the order and dates of their appointments and dismissals cannot be recovered. They are therefore noted here.
